# Free People

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 15 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Free People is a public clothing shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.freepeople.com](https://www.freepeople.com) on 2026-11-22. The country chip read SG ($). Product prices on the opened pages were USD. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, the Clothes menu, the clothes landing, one product, and Our Story were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The country chip says SG ($). The product page still showed $58.00. Do not treat the live hero, a product price, or the promo line as stable chrome. The promo bar rotates between shipping copy and a text-signup line.

Karla is the computed face. The file is not in this package. The style guide falls back to Helvetica, then Arial.

The wordmark in [icons/wordmark.svg](icons/wordmark.svg) is the public header SVG, fill `#2D2D2D`. [icon.png](icon.png) is the 512 px apple touch icon, resized to 128 px, not a screenshot crop of the header.

Phone width was not captured. Hover and focus were not measured as states. Menus other than Clothes were read from the homepage DOM after a mouseenter. The footer was not photographed, because it holds the email signup.
